vulnerabilityAlerts.description: Owner, 2026-11-16 (#6031): each security fix merges itself, major versions too, after the required checks of the ruleset main pass. GitHub auto-merge does the merge, so no check is skipped. The shared preset merges each minor, patch and digest update after each of its checks passes (#6547); this object adds the major security fixes.

customManagers.description: The Grafana plugins that Grafana preinstalls, pinned as <id>@<version> in the plugins value (#2022).
The Python minor of the setup-uv python-version inputs.
The Python minor of the type checkers and DEFAULT_PYTHON_VERSION.
The PostgreSQL image of a CloudNativePG Cluster (spec.imageName), which the kubernetes manager does not read. The Image Updater values hold a deeper imageName field.
The Mattermost version of the Mattermost resource, which names its image and tag in two fields.
The Gitea image tag. The chart gives the registry and the repository, so the helm-values manager cannot read it.
The DCGM exporter image tag, <DCGM version>-<exporter version>-<variant>. The exporter version is the version of the chart.
The one tag of the Argo Workflows controller and executor.

packageRules.description: OpenTofu reads its providers from the OpenTofu registry.

A file under src/devops_cli/ is runtime code, so the update is a fix: the Semantic PR title check refuses a hidden type there, and release-please releases it (#6061). Such a file is DEFAULT_PYTHON_VERSION. No custom manager writes a tool version into a file under src/ (#5585, #4363). A group takes the prefix of its first update, so each group with such a member sets the prefix itself: python runtime.
Lock file maintenance writes uv.lock and the root package-lock.json again, so it is a fix (#6061).
A custom manager of a file under k8s/ updates the cluster.
Renovate reads an Application source with no chart as a git dependency. Argo CD tracks main on purpose (ADR 0013), so those dependencies stay off.

Each Grafana plugin release names the Grafana it needs as grafanaDependency, which Renovate cannot read. A minor release can need a newer Grafana minor, so each plugin gets its own pull request, held to the major that the running Grafana major needs.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, check that the Grafana image of the `grafana` chart meets the `grafanaDependency` of this release: https://grafana.com/api/plugins/{{{depName}}}/versions/{{{newVersion}}}. Grafana installs the pinned version at start.

packageRules.description: The Grafana drilldown app plugins stay on major 3.
The grafana-llm-app plugin stays on major 1.
SearXNG publishes many tags a day. A tag has no minimum release age (CONTRIBUTING.md, Dependency Versions). Each tag ends in a commit hash, which the versioning ignores.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, read the notes of the release on the engines that the settings keep, and run `devops k8s searxng-check` against the new image on the cluster (`docs/CLUSTER.md`, section SearXNG).

packageRules.description: An update of a base image of the root Dockerfile is a fix, so release-please releases it. The devtools image is the base of the runner image. The Python, uv and Node images are the bases of the Service and MCP server images. Other updates stay chore and release nothing alone, except a chart update.

A chart update changes the chart that deploy-stack and Argo CD install: deploy-stack reads the version from the Application of the chart (#6060). So the update is a fix, and release-please releases it (#6054).

The uv image of the Dockerfile and the setup-uv version inputs. The builds of the Service and MCP server images use that image. The runner image gets uv from the devtools image. The uv image is a fix by the base image rule. A group takes the prefix of its first update, so the group sets the prefix itself.
.node-version and the node image. The node image of the Dockerfile is a fix by the base image rule. A group takes the prefix of its first update, so the group sets the prefix itself.
Every Python 3.<minor> place. A new minor gets its own branch, so its Dashboard approval does not stop the digest and patch updates.
prBodyNotes: A new Python minor is a migration: change the other `python3.<minor>` paths (`git grep -n 'python3\.'`) and the `python:3.<minor>-slim` defaults under `src/` in this pull request, then run the full gate.

packageRules.description: The ruff dev dependency and the ruff-pre-commit hook.
The actionlint image of the ci.yml step. The runner image and the devcontainer get actionlint from the devtools image.

The devtools image of .devcontainer/Dockerfile, of the root Dockerfile and of each workflow that names it, for each manager: one pull request moves every reference. The runner image builds FROM the image, so the update is a fix. A group takes the prefix of its first update, so the group sets the prefix itself.
The DCGM exporter chart and image: the exporter version of the image tag is the version of the chart. A group takes the prefix of its first update, so the group sets the fix prefix of a chart update.

The OpenSpec devDependency of the root package.json and package-lock.json, which the npm manager updates (#6409). Each release comes on the day it is published, not on the schedule of the preset, so the project uses the newest skills and planning standard (#5078). The skills that OpenSpec generates change with its version, so the branch writes them again.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, run `npm ci --ignore-scripts` and `uv run --frozen devops openspec regenerate` on this branch and push the generated skills; Renovate runs no upgrade task until #6020. The regeneration needs Git and access to github.com, because OpenSpec installs its skills from the release tag of its repository.
Before the merge, record OpenSpec again for the tests that replay it (`tests/support/openspec_recording.py` says how), and run `uv run devops openspec check`.

packageRules.description: A feature update writes the devcontainer lockfile again with the Dev Containers CLI of the devtools image.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, run `devcontainer upgrade --workspace-folder . --config .devcontainer/image/devcontainer.json` in the devcontainer on this branch and push `.devcontainer/image/devcontainer-lock.json`; Renovate runs no upgrade task until #6020.

packageRules.description: A LiteLLM release can change the gateway configuration and its migrations.
prBodyNotes: Before the merge, follow the upgrade plan of #4406: read the release notes and the migrations, and load `k8s/llm/gateway/config.yaml` with the new release.

packageRules.description: A person runs devops k8s searxng-check against each new SearXNG image on the cluster, so a SearXNG update waits for an approval on the Dependency Dashboard. It gets its own branch, so that the other container images do not wait for it (#6029, #6051).
